name: PeopleWhiz
instructions: Open https://www.peoplewhiz.com/optout and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: PeopleWhiz may ask for a copy of an ID by fax or mail. If it does, black out the ID number and photo before sending, or skip it: OpenOptOut never sends ID documents.
source: Process per redact.dev's PeopleWhiz removal guide (updated 2026-09-09).
